Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Replace the claim that every exec mutation commits separately: batched mode buffers consecutive mutations, flushes before reads, and returns compact receipts; immediate mode remains available.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Show bound canvas access, compact reads and revision-scoped handles; single and atomic-batch diagram tools; saved contexts, CanvasViews, projections, review, DiffSession and push operations; and AgentChat routes, events and generation status.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |   |   `-- Distinguish live browser dispatch, isolated ChangeSession copies and headless managed-generation children. Update the exec/version-guard contract without claiming a shipped backend-authority consolidation.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |   |   |-- Establish AgentChatService as the owner of chats, turns, captured references, direct supplied-edit batches, generation children, cancellation and parent synchronization; FileChatStore persists its sessions. AgentChat tools call the existing agent session service.
  |   |   |-- Establish GenerationCanvasBridge as an AgentChatService-managed child-canvas target: it owns isolated controllers, mutation receipts and persisted child histories; parent view capture and result updates still dispatch to the browser.
  |   |   `-- Place AgentContextLibrary with saved-context storage, DiffSessionWorkflowService with ChangeSession orchestration, and PushIntegrationService with repository-event delivery and workflow initiation. Keep their detailed responsibilities with their existing owners.
  |   |-- [2] Add: AgentChat conversations and supplied diagram edits
  |   |   `-- Attach from the new AgentChatService component in the backend parent. Specify chats, turn bindings, captured references, direct edits, atomic batches, cancellation and FileChatStore using application/mapping/agent-chat/agentChatService.ts:1-590, chatDiagramTools.ts:1-269, domain/mapping/agent-chat/agentChat.ts:1-144 and infrastructure/mapping/agent-chat/chatStore.ts:1-25; reuse the existing supplied-edit diagram rather than duplicate it.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Managed CanvasView alternative generation
  |       `-- Attach from the new GenerationCanvasBridge component in the backend parent, connected to AgentChatService. Specify saved-parent capture, independent child chats/controllers, headless edits, cancellation, persistence and browser parent synchronization using application/mapping/agent-chat/agentChatService.ts:145-320, generationCanvasBridge.ts:1-94, domain/core/diagrams/canvasGeneration.ts:1-26 and domain/core/diagrams/canvasHistory.ts:299-371; reuse Saved CanvasViews and branching for view behavior.
